QuestInfo.name: Mechanic Launch Commemorative Event: Premium Supply Support!
QuestInfo.0: Mechanics have arrived to the revamped Maple World! In addition to the reinforcements, Cassandra is giving out supplies that will help the Resistance fight the Black Mage. Make sure you go see her.
QuestInfo.1: Cassandra is out providing supplies to help the fight against the Black Mage!\nGo see Cassandra before it's too late.
QuestInfo.2: You received supplies from Cassandra. \nContinue to grow stronger so that you can defeat the Black Mage alongside the Mechanics!

0.0: So you're the friend who didn't receive the Supply a while ago. Are you now ready to receive the Supply?

yes.0: I will give you the supply when you come see me. But, you have to be here before 8 pm. Don't be late.

no.0: You're still not ready to receive the Supply Box? Remember, you will not be able to receive it after 8 pm today.

1.0: Here is the Supply Box. Check your Inventory.

yes.0: You can use the supplies in the box by clicking on the Supply Box. Make great use of it.

default.0: You're so unprepared... What a shame...
